book.name: MATEO
book.title: JA' WATX' K'ANE TZ'IBEBIL CAN YU NAJ MATEO

content: Scamichal Naj Juan Bautista
Ja' naj Herodes, naj yaawil yul yet Galilea, jix yab sk'aneal Jesús naj yet jun tiempoal tu',
Yuxan jix yal naj tet eb ey oc yopiso yalan naj jaxca ti': —Ja' jun naj tu', ja' ton naj Juan Bautista, pitzc'unaj a naj xol eb camnaj. Yuxan ey yipal yunen wan milagro tu', ẍi naj tet eb.

Quey tu' jix yute naj yalon jaxca tu', yutol camnaj xa naj Juan tu' yu naj. Jaxca ti' jix yune' yuxan ak'bil cam naj yu. Ey jun yuẍtaj naj Herodes tu', chi yij Felipe. Herodías sbi yistil. Ja' naj Herodes tu', jix smonte el yistil yuẍtaj tu'. Yuxan jix yal naj Juan tet naj Herodes jaxca ti': —Caw man smoo oj cha yi' ix ti', ẍi naj Juan tu' tet naj. Yuxan jix ak'le sc'ul naj Herodes tu' yu ix. Catu' jix ak'le mitx'le naj Juan tu', catu' jix oc naj yul preso, jix oc cadena yin naj.
Jix yoche naj Herodes tu', chi yak' cam naj Juan tu', pero chi xiw naj tet eb conob. Yutol chi sna' eb ánima masanil tol ẍejab Dios ye naj Juan tu':
Ja' yet jix ẍa'on sk'inal ya'bilal naj Herodes xin, jix syamba oc eb ánima. Jix canalwi ix yune' Herodías tu' sattaj eb masanil. Caw sak'al yec' ix jix yil naj Herodes tu'.
Yuxan jix sloctej sbi Dios catu' jix yak'on sti' tet ix jaxca ti': —Yal c'al tzet oj ja k'an e in an, oj wak' e ach an, ẍi naj tet ix.
Pero ak'bil xa sc'ul ix yu xutx, yuxan jix yal ix jaxca ti': —Ja' sjolom naj Juan Bautista cha wak' yul junoj plato e in an, ẍi ix tet naj Herodes tu'.
Ja' yet jix yaben naj rey tu' jaxca tu' xin, caw jix cus a sc'ul naj. Pero xax sloctej sbi Dios naj. Jix yab pax eb ey ec' yetoj naj. Yuxan jix yala, tol chi ak'le tet ix.
Jix yak'on orden naj tol chi to i'le el sjolom naj Juan tu' yul preso.
Jix bet eb catu' jix i'letej sjolom naj Juan tu' yul junoj plato, catu' jix yak'on eb tet ix, catu' jix yak'on ix tet xutx.
Catu' jix apni eb scuywom naj Juan tu', catu' jix yi'ontoj smimanil naj eb, catu' jix smujon can eytoj eb. Jix lawi tu' xin, jix to yalon eb tet Jesús tzet jix yun scam naj.
Ja' Yet Jix Low Eb Joeb Mil Winaj Yu Jesús

Ja' yet jix yaben Jesús jun tu' xin, catu' jix octoj yul jun barco yetoj eb scuywom tu', catu' jix to eb bey jun cusiltaj tx'otx' xojli. Ja' yet jix yaben a sk'umal eb ánima bey conoblaj, jix to eb yetoj yajan catu' jix to eb bey oj apnoj Jesús tu'.
Ja' yet jix eltej Jesús yul barco tu' xin, jix yilon jun miman bulan ánima ey xa ec' titu'. Jix ok' sc'ul naj yin eb, catu' jix yak'on can wa'xoj sc'ul eb ya' ey eb i'bil oc oj.

Jaxa yet yey c'ualil tu' jix apni eb scuywom sc'atan, catu' jix yalon eb tet naj jaxca ti': —Ilala, lalan sto c'u, cusiltaj tx'otx' pax bey ey jon ec' ti', yuxan tejan watx' ta cha chej pax eb ánima ti' bey wan aldealaj cu cawil-laj ti', yet watx' chi to sman low sba eb, ẍi eb tet Jesús.
—¿Tzet yuxan oj toj sman low sba eb? Ak' wej low eb jaexti', ẍi naj tet eb scuywom tu'.
—Pero asan ch'an joeb cu yali' pan i'bil, yetoj cac'on no' pescado, ẍi eb tet naj.
—I' wej tej e in an xin, ẍi naj tet eb.

Catu' jix yalon tet eb ánima bulan ec' titu', tol chi ey chotan eb sat ac'al tu', catu' jix yi'on a ixim joeb pan tu' c'al no' cac'on pescado. Jix a t'anan satcan, catu' jix yalon yu diosalil yu. Jix spo'on ey ixim pan tu', catu' jix yak'on tet eb scuywom. Ja' eb jix po'ontoj xol ánima.
Jix low eb masanil xin, catu' jix no can sc'ul eb. Jix lawi tu', catu' jix syamban a ixim jix can can sobra oj tu', lacaweb to xuc ixim jix yamcha a oj.
Joeb mil eb winaj jix lowi, pero ma bisle eb ix c'al eb unin.
Yet Jix Bey Jesús Yiban Ja' Mar
Jix lawi jun tu' xin, catu' jix yalon Jesús tet eb scuywom tol chi octoj eb yul barco, catu' chi babi k'axpon ec'toj eb, yajban chi yal to sba naj tet eb ánima bulan ec' titu'.
Jix lawi yalon to sba tet eb ánima tu' xin, catu' jix to bey jun wonan txaloj xojli. Ey xa ec' titu' xojli catu' jix k'ejbi ey oj.
Jal eb scuywom xin, ey xa ec' eb snan ja' yetoj te' barco tu'. Lalan xa pitxlo te' yu ja', yutol caw jow stit ka'e' sattaj eb.
Tuxa chi sajbi catu' jix apni Jesús yintaj eb. Jix bey naj yetoj yajan yiban ja'.
Ja' yet jix yilontoj eb cuywom tu', tol chi bey naj yiban ja', jix xiw a eb yu. Jix el yaw eb yu xiw c'ulal, jix yalon eb jaxca ti': —Jix jul jun cu lab, ẍi eb.
Catu' jix yalon naj tet eb jaxca ti': —Manchej jex oc il. Jain Jesús jin ti' an. Manchej jex xiwi, ẍi naj tet eb.
Catu' jix yalon naj Pedro tu' tet Jesús: —Wuẍtaj, ta yel jaach, chej jin bey yiban ja', catu' chin to e ach tu' an, ẍi naj tet Jesús.
—Sebach, ẍi Jesús tet naj. Catu' jix eytej naj Pedro yul te' barco tu', catu' jix yak'len naj sto sc'atan Jesús.
Ja' yet jix yabeni tol caw jow ka'e', jix xiw a oj. Jix yabeni, tol lalan spax ey xol ja', yuxan jix a yaw: —Wuẍtaj, col jin an, ẍi naj tet Jesús.
Eyman jix oc mitx'an Jesús yin sk'ab naj catu' jix yalon tet naj jaxca ti': —Jaachti', c'am cha waoc ja c'ul win an. ¿Tzet yuxan jix ja wak' caab c'ulal? ẍi Jesús tet naj Pedro tu'.
Catu' ja' yet jix octoj eb yul te' barco tu' xin, catu' jix oc tucan jun ka'e' tu'.
Jix yi'on ey sba eb ey xa c'al ta' octoj yul te' barco tu' tet Jesús, catu' jix yalon eb tet naj jaxca ti': —Caw yel Sc'aal jaach Dios jaachti', ẍi eb cuywom tu' tet Jesús.
Jix Wa'xi Can Sc'ul Eb Ya' Ey a Genesaret Yu Jesús
Jix k'axpo ec' eb xin, jix ec' apnoj eb bey conob Genesaret.
Ja' yet jix yilon oc eb ánima tol ja' Jesús jun jix juli, jix abcha el yul-laj masanil jun lugar tu', catu' jix i'letej masanil eb ya' ey bey ey ec' naj Jesús.
Jix sk'anon eb ta asan tol chi smitx' nioj sti' spichil naj. Ja' masanil eb jix mitx'on sti' spichil naj tu', jix wa'xi can sc'ul eb.
